criteria.silhouette_scale: Concept retains compact stepped cabinet and lower rear mass. Its base is slightly exaggerated; actual stone feet and exact half-grid dimensions remain the implementation authority.
criteria.implementable_geometry: All visible landmarks translate to existing cube/cut-block faces. No new modeled fittings needed; dial and hatch are painted.
criteria.mechanics_clearance: No motion or new mechanical connections; existing ports remain accessible.
criteria.period_materials: Medium steel plates and iron fasteners; brass appears only at the enamel dial. No ornamental copper slab or gears.
criteria.family_consistency: Steel values and ivory/brass controls agree with Oil Engine. Broader quiet patches deliberately reduce the earlier streaks and fine noise.
criteria.controls_readability: Referenced four-face atlases give heater, column, condenser, tank and drill distinct large fittings. Cold heater is an explicit edit. Protected outer borders enforce exact casing continuity despite generator drift.
criteria.gameplay_scope: Texture refresh only; all six industrial controller faces are new original artwork. Gauges/sight glasses remain decorative, not live telemetry. Previous geometry, production and interactions remain unchanged.

criteria.matches_direction: Native 32-pixel plate has the broad quiet steel face, iron corner fixings and restrained dark seam from the concept. Pump dial/hatch remain separate landmarks.
criteria.geometry_uvs: Texture-only native orientable cube, same front direction as existing blockstates. Existing cut-block geometry and UV sampling retained; complete assembly checked next in Photon.
criteria.material_consistency: Ten faces share one bounded palette and one Photon brightness curve. Protected borders/corners are identical. Every fitting is newly generated from the same master/reference chain; no legacy device insert remains.
criteria.assembly_interfaces: No structure, support, port, collision or guide geometry changes. Existing refinery-side resource keeps every industrial body using the same material.
criteria.animation_states: New heater cold face replaces only the 10x5 inspection-window region from a referenced extinguished edit; entire remaining face is identical. Shared heat palette keeps small orange flame pixels from being lost in reduction.
criteria.native_size_readability: Native previews show distinct silhouettes for pump dial/hatch, heater octagonal door, column instrument pair, condenser louvers/dial, tank vertical level and drill semicircular gauge. Photon-adjusted steel midtone remains quiet.

criteria.photon_materials: Reviewed final Photon/Faithful controller lineup, refinery assembly and pump front/rear. Shared brighter steel reads as plates in shade and daylight; iron fittings remain darker and ivory/brass instrumentation stays distinct.
criteria.scale_readability: All six distinct controller designs read in world and native inventory hotbar. Broad surface patches remain subordinate to plate edges. Condenser louvers are readable across its full assembled face.
criteria.states_motion: Working heater shows orange inspection slits in the assembly; stopped lineup heater is dark. No new motion. Build and connected refinery fixture passed after updating its Foundry/heater setup for manual ignition.
criteria.interaction_guides: Column missing-block screenshot shows the same new plate material in its translucent contextual guide. Pump complete front/rear show unchanged cut-piece fit and supports; attempted separate pump guide capture did not show the guide and is not claimed as evidence.
criteria.inventory_appearance: Six controller icons appear correctly textured in the creative inventory hotbar. Casing held appearance also reviewed beside the column.
criteria.integration_limits: Art and native static model changes only; no gameplay changes or new gauge telemetry. No moving-vessel or additional shader testing. Existing engine/canister dedicated artwork retained; engine bed shares the new casing but was not separately launched.
